task.title: Fix fullscreen chat textarea not filling space, void under buttons

decision.what: Chrome's toolbar auto-hide cannot reach the ✦ sheet — position:fixed is the real wall, not the nested scroll thread alone — see doc/sheet.md

closing the ✦ sheet no longer stops its mic — hide()'s own stop_mic() call, not the mic-hijack visibilitychange rule, was the real cause; only the window-widened-past-52em hide still stops it — see doc/sheet.md
